SELECT r.legal_name AS company,
    r.funding_limit,
    COALESCE(ap.approved, (0)::numeric) AS approved,
    COALESCE(k.contracted, (0)::numeric) AS contracted,
    (r.funding_limit - COALESCE(k.contracted, (0)::numeric)) AS remaining
   FROM ((reg.counterparty r
     LEFT JOIN ( SELECT application.company_inn,
            sum(application.amount) AS approved
           FROM api.application
          WHERE (application.status_id = priv.status_id('Одобрена'::text))
          GROUP BY application.company_inn) ap ON ((ap.company_inn = r.inn)))
     LEFT JOIN ( SELECT a.company_inn,
            sum(k_1.amount) AS contracted
           FROM (api.contract k_1
             JOIN api.application a ON ((a.id = k_1.application_id)))
          GROUP BY a.company_inn) k ON ((k.company_inn = r.inn)));

args.query: select * from api.status; select * from reg.counterparty; select c.*, a.company_inn, a.status_id from api.contract c left join api.application a on a.id=c.application_id;

select r.legal_name, coalesce(ap.s,0) ap, coalesce(k.s,0) k, coalesce(ap.s,0)-coalesce(k.s,0) d from reg.counterparty r left join (select company_inn, sum(amount) s from api.application where status_id=20003 group by 1) ap on ap.company_inn=r.inn left join (select a.company_inn, sum(c.amount) s from api.contract c join api.application a on a.id=c.application_id group by 1) k on k.company_inn=r.inn order by d desc
